join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add error (_TESTING_ERROR_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'error' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!error hello
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add nestederror (_HEY_(_TESTING_ERROR_)_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'nestederror' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!nestederror hello
no_send
